contract_title: Term Loan Facility - Notice & Acceleration Schedule

variables.name: mandatory_grace_period_days
variables.description: Mandatory Cure Period in business days following Notice of Default

variables.name: acceleration_threshold_days
variables.description: Days of non-payment required before lender can declare immediate acceleration

variables.name: cure_days_elapsed
variables.description: Days currently elapsed since formal notice

clauses.title: Notice and Mandatory Grace Period
clauses.original_text: The Borrower shall be entitled to an absolute Cure Period of not less than 15 Business Days following the date of receipt of such Notice of Default before any remedial enforcement action may be initiated.

clauses.title: Immediate Acceleration Remedy
clauses.original_text: If any payment of principal or interest remains unpaid for five (5) Business Days after the scheduled payment date, the Administrative Agent may declare the entire loan immediately due and payable.

invariants.name: Temporal Precedence: Cure Window Exceeds Acceleration Trigger
invariants.description: Remedial acceleration cannot be triggered at a day count strictly lower than the guaranteed statutory cure window.
